review.requirement_proposition: Appropriate mechanisms should allow AI systems risking undue harm or exhibiting unwanted behaviour to be safely overridden, repaired or decommissioned as needed.
review.reason_for_change: The unwanted access/service behaviour directly engages the OECD repair proposition. TechRadar preserved a fix by about 10:58 GMT and all systems operational by 11:59; the separate quota report describes a reset for affected paid accounts without establishing the proposed sub-agent cause. This affirmatively supports repair in the reported restoration stage, bounded to the disclosed affected scope. It does not establish prevention of recurrence, full internal controls or every individual user outcome.
